headline: Google Photos has added 15 new AI 'Remix' templates that turn your pictures into deliberately silly versions of themselves.
score_reason: Pool score 1 kept: a light consumer feature written up by one reviewer.
importance_line: Phone users aged 18 and over in selected countries can try it first, with Google as the maker, and the doubt is that the results are plainly artificial and the story is one writer's opinion.
summary: Android Police reports that Google Photos has added 15 new 'Remix' templates, which use AI to turn a user's photo into a playful new picture, including odd ones named washing machine, fish eye and microwave. The writer calls it silly but fun, and says the new templates are only for users aged 18 and over in selected countries.
notes: Read from the pre-fetched page. Opinion and hands-on piece.
